item.title: Overworld 0.1.0
item.description:
• First release. Overworld shows your Claude Code agents as residents of a small town, and only watches: it never blocks, approves or changes anything in Claude Code.
  • Updates arrive on their own. Overworld checks once a day and asks nothing while you are busy; when a new version is ready, the app menu and the menu bar item read "Update to ...".
